appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Increasing River Restoration Capacity from 2018 to 2023'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Capacity Index' with tick marks at 0, 400, 800, 1,200, 1,600, 2,000, 2,400, and 2,800.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 2018 to 2023.
The line starts at the year 2018, at a value of 2,800 on the Capacity Index axis.
The line dips to a value of 2,400 in 2019.
The line peaks at a value of 2,800 in 2020.
The line remains flat at a value of 2,400 from 2021 through 2023.
